source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 8 exercise solved (PDF 185-188): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short questions, calculations step by step, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Chemical Equilibrium) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Is chapter ki exercise mein sirf MCQs aur short questions chhape hain. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah di gayi hai (kitab MCQs ki answer key nahi deti); short sawalon ke model jawab aur hisabi sawalon (j, k) ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. For which system, does the equilibrium constant, Kc has units of (concentration)⁻¹?
(Kis system ke equilibrium constant Kc ki unit (concentration)⁻¹ hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kc ki unit = (concentration)^Δn, Δn = products ke moles − reactants ke moles. 2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄ mein Δn = 1 − 2 = −1, is liye Kc = [N₂O₄]/[NO₂]² ki unit (mol dm⁻³)⁻¹. (a) mein Δn = −2 (unit mol⁻² dm⁶); (b) aur (d) mein Δn = 0 (koi unit nahi) (8.8.2).

blocks.prompt:
II. Which statement about the following equilibrium is correct?
2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g)  ∆H = −197.9 kJ mol⁻¹
(Is equilibrium ke bare mein kaunsa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Temperature barhne se Kp ki qeemat ghatti hai.
Pressure barhne se Kp ki qeemat ghatti hai.
V₂O₅ catalyst dalne se SO₃ ki equilibrium paidawar barhti hai.
Kp ki qeemat Kc ke barabar hai.

blocks.explanation: Forward reaction exothermic hai, is liye temperature barhane se reverse reaction ko faida hota hai aur equilibrium constant ghatta hai (8.14). Pressure sirf position badalta hai, Kp nahi; catalyst paidawar nahi badalta (8.15); Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn aur Δn = −1, is liye Kp ≠ Kc.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (c) mein 'increase' chhapa hai; durust 'increases' hai. Kitab mein lafz 'EXERCISE' MCQs se pehle ki bajaye is sawal ke baad chhapa hai.

blocks.prompt:
III. 2SO₃(g) ⇌ 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g)
The conventional equilibrium constant expression (Kc) for the system as described by the above equation is:
(Oopar ki equation ke liye Kc ka durust expression kaunsa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kc = products apne coefficients ki power ke saath, taqseem reactants apne coefficients ki power ke saath: Kc = [SO₂]²[O₂]/[SO₃]² (8.8).

blocks.prompt:
IV. A saturated solution represents a dynamic equilibrium. Macroscopically, the concentration of dissolved solute is constant. Microscopically, this occurs because:
(Saturated solution dynamic equilibrium hai. Macroscopic tor par hal shuda solute ki concentration constant hai. Microscopic tor par aisa kyun hai?)

options.text: Mazeed solute particles hal nahi ho rahe.
Solute ke hal hone ki raftar zero hai.
Solute particles barabar raftar se hal bhi ho rahe hain aur wapas solid bhi ban rahe hain.
Tamam solute particles hal ho chuke hain.

blocks.explanation: Dynamic equilibrium mein dono mukhalif amal barabar raftar se jari rehte hain, is liye koi khalis tabdeeli nazar nahi aati (8.2, 8.4).

blocks.prompt:
V. Which of the following statements correctly describes the effect of temperature on the equilibrium constant?
(Temperature ka equilibrium constant par asar kaunsa bayan durust batata hai?)

options.text: Kc temperature ke seedha mutanasib hai.
Kc temperature ke ulta mutanasib hai.
Kc (par temperature ka asar) reaction ke enthalpy change par munhasir hai.
Temperature ka Kc par koi asar nahi.

blocks.explanation: Temperature hi wahid cheez hai jo Kc badalti hai, aur simt ΔH par munhasir hai: exothermic reaction mein garam karne se Kc ghatta hai, endothermic mein barhta hai (8.14). Is liye yeh sirf seedha ya ulta mutanasib nahi.

blocks.prompt:
VI. Consider the gas-phase equilibrium system represented by the equation:
2H₂O(g) ⇌ 2H₂(g) + O₂(g)
Given that the forward reaction is endothermic, which of the following changes will decrease the equilibrium amount of H₂O?
(Forward reaction endothermic hai. Kaunsi tabdeeli H₂O ki equilibrium miqdaar kam karegi?)

options.text: Bartan ka volume kam karna (kul pressure barhta hai)

blocks.explanation: Endothermic forward reaction mein garmi forward ko faida deti hai, is liye H₂O kam hota hai (8.14). O₂ dalna aur volume kam karna (baayen taraf 2 mol gas, daayen 3 mol) equilibrium ko baayen le jate hain aur H₂O barhate hain; catalyst miqdaar nahi badalta.

blocks.prompt:
VII. Kc = 0.040 for the reaction given below at 450 °C:
PCl₅(g) ⇌ PCl₃(g) + Cl₂(g)
Evaluate Kp for the reaction at 450 °C.
(450 °C par Kc = 0.040 hai. Isi temperature par Kp maloom karein.)

VIII. In which of the following gaseous equilibria, pressure has no effect on the equilibrium position?
(Kis gaseous equilibrium mein pressure ka equilibrium position par koi asar nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Jab gaseous reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon to pressure ka asar nahi hota (8.13). (c) mein dono taraf 2 mol gas hai.

blocks.prompt:
IX. Consider the equilibrium 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2H₂O(g). If the concentration of H₂O(g) is increased, the concentrations of H₂(g) and O₂(g) will:
(2H₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2H₂O(g) mein H₂O(g) ki concentration barhai jaye to H₂(g) aur O₂(g) ki concentrations:)
blocks.explanation: Product barhane se equilibrium reverse simt mein jata hai (Le Chatelier's principle, 8.12), kuch H₂O toot-ta hai aur H₂ aur O₂ ki concentrations barhti hain.

blocks.prompt:
X. For a specific reaction, the value of the equilibrium constant, Kc:
(Kisi khaas reaction ke equilibrium constant Kc ki qeemat:)

options.text: mukhtalif halaat mein hamesha wahi rehti hai.
kisi product ki concentration barhane se barhti hai.
kisi reactant ki concentration barhane se barhti hai.

blocks.explanation: Kc concentrations par munhasir nahi; yeh sirf temperature par munhasir hai (8.6, 8.14). Concentration badalne se sirf position khisakti hai.

blocks.prompt:
XI. For a saturated solution of a salt in water, a dynamic equilibrium is between:
(Paani mein namak ke saturated solution mein dynamic equilibrium kin ke darmiyan hai?)

options.text: Hal shuda ions aur na-hal shuda solid namak
Solid namak aur paani ke molecules
Hydrated ions aur baqi paani ke molecules

blocks.explanation: Ions solid se nikal kar hal hote hain aur mehlool se ions wapas solid par jamte hain, dono barabar raftar se: solid ⇌ hal shuda ions.

blocks.text: Q.2 Neeche diye gaye mukhtasar sawalon ke jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. What is meant by the state of chemical equilibrium?
(Chemical equilibrium ki halat se kya murad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reversible reaction ki woh halat jis mein reaction mixture ki banawat nahi badalti aur forward aur reverse reactions ki raftar barabar hoti hai. Is waqt reactants aur products ki concentrations constant rehti hain (8.2).

blocks.prompt:
b. Define reversible reaction. Give an example.
(Reversible reaction ki tareef karein aur misal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Woh reaction jo dono simton, forward aur reverse, mein chalta hai, yani products dobara react kar ke reactants bana dete hain; band bartan mein yeh kabhi mukammal nahi hota aur equilibrium tak pohanchta hai (8.1).
Misal: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g)

blocks.prompt:
c. Decide the comparative magnitudes of Kc and Kp, for the following reversible reactions.
(i) Ammonia synthesis (ii) Dissociation of PCl₅
(In reversible reactions ke liye Kc aur Kp mein kaun bara hai, faisla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn, aur RT > 1 (R = 0.0821 dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, T kelvin mein) (8.9).
(i) N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃: Δn = 2 − 4 = −2, Kp = Kc/(RT)², is liye Kp < Kc.
(ii) PCl₅ ⇌ PCl₃ + Cl₂: Δn = 2 − 1 = +1, Kp = Kc(RT), is liye Kp > Kc.

blocks.prompt:
d. The change of volume disturbs the equilibrium position for some of the gas phase reactions but not the equilibrium constant.
(Volume ki tabdeeli kuch gas reactions ki equilibrium position to badal deti hai magar equilibrium constant nahi. Wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Volume badalne se tamam gases ki concentrations aik saath badalti hain. Agar dono taraf gas ke moles mukhtalif hon (Δn ≠ 0) to Qc ki nisbat Kc ke barabar nahi rehti, is liye reaction khisakta hai (volume kam ho to kam moles ki taraf) yahan tak ke nisbat phir usi Kc ke barabar ho jaye. Kc sirf temperature par munhasir hai, is liye nahi badalta; agar Δn = 0 ho to position bhi nahi badalti (8.13).

blocks.prompt:
e. Mention the characteristics of chemical equilibrium.
(Chemical equilibrium ki khasusiyaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Reactants aur products ki concentrations constant rehti hain; forward aur reverse raftar barabar (dynamic).
2. Is tak dono taraf se pohancha ja sakta hai, reactants se shuru karein ya products se.
3. Catalyst equilibrium position ya K nahi badalta; sirf equilibrium jaldi lata hai.
4. K ibtidai concentrations par munhasir nahi; sirf temperature par. Yeh sirf band system mein qaim hota hai (8.5, 8.6).

blocks.prompt:
f. Reversible reaction attains the position of equilibrium which is dynamic in nature and not static. Explain it.
(Reversible reaction jis equilibrium tak pohanchta hai woh dynamic hai, static nahi. Wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Equilibrium par concentrations badalna band ho jati hain, is liye lagta hai reaction ruk gaya (static). Magar microscopic level par reactant molecules products banate rehte hain aur product molecules reactants; dono reactions barabar raftar se jari rehte hain, is liye khalis tabdeeli nahi hoti. Maslan H₂O(g) + CO(g) ⇌ H₂(g) + CO₂(g) mein dono simton mein bonds tootte aur bante rehte hain (8.2).

blocks.prompt:
g. Why do the rates of forward reactions slow down when a reversible reaction approaches the equilibrium stage?
(Reversible reaction equilibrium ke qareeb pohanchne par forward reaction ki raftar kyun kam ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Forward raftar reactants ki concentration par munhasir hai. Reactants istemal hone se un ki concentration ghatti hai, fi second takkarein kam hoti hain aur forward raftar kam ho jati hai; saath hi products barhte hain aur reverse raftar barhti hai yahan tak ke dono barabar ho jati hain (8.2).

blocks.prompt:
h. Why ice at 0 °C can be melted by applying pressure without supply of heat from outside?
(0 °C par barf ko bahar se heat diye baghair sirf pressure se kyun pighlaya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 0 °C par barf aur paani dynamic equilibrium mein hain: barf ⇌ paani. Barf utne hi mass ke paani se zyada jagah leti hai (taqreeban 9% zyada). Le Chatelier's principle ke mutabiq pressure barhne se woh tabdeeli hoti hai jo volume kam kare, is liye equilibrium paani ki taraf jata hai aur barf pighalti hai. Pressure melting point ko 0 °C se neeche kar deta hai; pighalne ki heat barf-paani system se hi aati hai jis ka temperature thora gir jata hai (chapter se bahar).

blocks.prompt:
i. Write two conditions of equilibrium constant.
(Equilibrium constant ki do sharait likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Reaction reversible ho aur equilibrium tak pohanch chuka ho; Kc mein equilibrium wali concentrations dali jati hain.
2. System band ho taake koi reactant ya product bahar na nikle, aur temperature constant ho, kyun ke Kc sirf temperature se badalta hai (8.5, 8.6).

blocks.prompt:
j. At 445 °C, Kc for the following reaction is 0.020.
2HI(g) ⇌ H₂(g) + I₂(g)
A mixture of H₂, I₂, and HI in a vessel at 445 °C has the following concentrations: [HI] = 2.0 M, [H₂] = 0.50 M and [I₂] = 0.10 M. Which one of the following statements concerning the reaction quotient, Qc, is TRUE for the above system?
i) Qc = Kc; the system is at equilibrium.
ii) Qc is less than Kc; more H₂ and I₂ will be produced.
iii) Qc is less than Kc; more HI will be produced.
iv) Qc is greater than Kc; more H₂ and I₂ will be produced.
(445 °C par Kc = 0.020 hai. Di gayi concentrations par reaction quotient Qc ke bare mein kaunsa bayan durust hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: Kc = 0.020, [HI] = 2.0 M, [H₂] = 0.50 M, [I₂] = 0.10 M
Qc = [H₂][I₂] / [HI]²
Qc = (0.50 × 0.10) / (2.0)² = 0.050 / 4.0
Qc = 0.0125
Qc (0.0125) < Kc (0.020), is liye system equilibrium par nahi; forward reaction chalega yahan tak ke Qc = Kc ho, aur mazeed H₂ aur I₂ banenge.
Durust bayan: (ii)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kc ki qeemat kitab mein Urdu (Arabic-Indic) hindson mein, comma ko decimal bana kar chhapi hai; yeh 0.020 hai, jaisa yahan likha hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Qc ka formula bilkul Kc jaisa hai, farq sirf yeh ke is mein us waqt ki (equilibrium se pehle ki) concentrations dalte hain. Qc < Kc: reaction aage (products ki taraf); Qc > Kc: peeche (reactants ki taraf); Qc = Kc: equilibrium.

blocks.prompt:
k. The reversible reaction:
2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g)
has come to equilibrium in a vessel of specific volume at a given temperature. Before the reaction began, the concentrations of the reactants were 0.060 mol/dm³ of SO₂ and 0.050 mol/dm³ of O₂. After equilibrium is reached, the concentration of SO₃ is 0.040 mol/dm³. What is the equilibrium concentration of O₂?
(Reaction se pehle SO₂ 0.060 mol/dm³ aur O₂ 0.050 mol/dm³ tha. Equilibrium par SO₃ 0.040 mol/dm³ hai. Equilibrium par O₂ ki concentration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
2SO₂ + O₂ ⇌ 2SO₃ (mole ki nisbat 2 : 1 : 2)
Shuru mein: SO₂ 0.060, O₂ 0.050, SO₃ 0 mol dm⁻³
Bana SO₃ = 0.040 mol dm⁻³
Istemal hua O₂ = ½ × 0.040 = 0.020 mol dm⁻³ (istemal hua SO₂ = 0.040 mol dm⁻³)
Equilibrium par [O₂] = 0.050 − 0.020 = 0.030 mol dm⁻³
(aur [SO₂] = 0.060 − 0.040 = 0.020 mol dm⁻³)
Jawab: [O₂] = 0.030 mol/dm³

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aisa sawal 'shuru, tabdeeli, equilibrium' ki table bana kar hal karein. Balanced equation ke coefficients batate hain ke 2 mole SO₃ banne ke liye 1 mole O₂ kharch hota hai, is liye O₂ ki kami SO₃ ki aadhi hai.

items: MCQs ke jawab: I c, II a, III b, IV c, V c, VI d, VII c, VIII c, IX a, X c, XI a.
Kitab ki ghaltiyan: MCQ II (c) mein 'increase' ('increases' hona chahiye) aur lafz 'EXERCISE' is sawal ke baad chhapa hai; short j mein Kc Urdu hindson mein chhapa hai (0.020).
Hisab: MCQ VII Kp = 2.4; short j Qc = 0.0125 < Kc, durust bayan (ii); short k [O₂] = 0.030 mol/dm³.
